description: Na₄Al₃BSi₃(HO₃)₄ crystallizes in the cubic P̅43n space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three equivalent H and three equivalent O atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.54 Å. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.32 Å. Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.74 Å. B is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent H atoms. All B-H bond lengths are 1.22 Å. Si is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.63 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to three equivalent Na and one B atom. O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
